task_completion.description: The agent loads the aav2_genome.fasta file into the UGENE interface.
task_completion.visual_evidence: UGENE window showing 'aav2_genome.fasta' open in the Sequence View or Project View.

task_completion.description: The agent opens the 'Find Inverted Repeats' dialog and sets the window size to 50 and minimum identity to 85%.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Find Inverted Repeats' dialog box with 'Window size' set to 50 and 'Min identity' set to 85%.

task_completion.description: The agent selects the 'disjoint repeats nested filter' algorithm in the repeat finder settings.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Find Inverted Repeats' dialog showing the 'Disjoint repeats (nested)' filter selected.

task_completion.description: The agent exports the sequence with found repeats to a GenBank (.gb) file in the specified directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Export as Document' or 'Save' dialog showing the file path ~/UGENE_Data/gene_therapy/results/aav2_annotated.gb.

task_completion.description: The agent creates a text report containing the genome length and repeat count.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal showing the creation of 'itr_report.txt' with a genome length of 4679 and the number of repeats found.

task_completion.description: The report includes the start and end coordinates for both the 5' and 3' ITRs.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The content of 'itr_report.txt' showing coordinates for the 5' ITR (approx 1-145) and 3' ITR (approx 4535-4679).

integrity.description: The agent used the UGENE GUI to perform the analysis rather than just writing the report via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the UGENE application window, dialog boxes, and mouse interactions with the software.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply echo the privileged information into the report without running the tool.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the 'Find Inverted Repeats' process running or the results appearing in the UGENE 'Annotations' pane.

integrity.description: The agent used the specific file paths requested in the task description.
integrity.visual_evidence: File paths in UGENE or terminal commands matching '~/UGENE_Data/gene_therapy/results/'.
